cli.cmd.local: Review the current branch against its base on this machine. Nothing is posted.
cli.cmd.doctor: Check git and the harnesses you have, and what each one can do.
cli.opt.base: Base ref to compare with (default: detected from origin).
cli.opt.uncommitted: Also review uncommitted changes to tracked files.
cli.opt.harness: Harness: auto, claude, codex, kiro, or one from your config.
cli.opt.verifierHarness: Harness for the verifier (default: the same as --harness).
cli.opt.lens: Run only these lenses, comma-separated. The verdict is then partial.
cli.opt.noVerify: Skip the verifier: faster, more false alarms.
cli.opt.lang: Language of the findings (default: your config, then your system language).
cli.opt.conformance: With doctor: run a real two-prompt test on each harness (uses a little quota).
error.noBase: Couldn't find a base branch. Pass one with --base.
error.diffTooLarge: The change has {lines} changed lines, over the limit of {limit} (limits.maxDiffLines).
error.noHarness: No harness installed. Install Claude Code, Codex or Kiro, or add one to your config, then run crewreview doctor.
error.harnessNotReadOnly: {name} can't be locked to read-only, so it can't review. Pick another harness.
error.needsConformance: {name} hasn't passed the read-only test yet. Run crewreview doctor --conformance first.
error.allLensesFailed: Every lens failed. See the errors above.
doctor.title: Crewreview doctor
doctor.conformanceHint: Run crewreview doctor --conformance to prove the read-only lock with a real run.
doctor.notReady: Not ready: no installed harness can review.
local.title: Crewreview · local review
local.droppedEvidence.one: {count} finding dropped for citing a file or line that doesn't exist.
local.droppedEvidence.other: {count} findings dropped for citing a file or line that doesn't exist.
reason.blocking-findings: a verified finding blocks the merge
reason.unverified-blockers: a blocker was found but not verified
reason.findings-block-approval: some findings are too serious to approve
reason.lens-failed: a lens failed or didn't cover everything
reason.diff-too-large: the change is too large to approve automatically
status.hallucinated: discarded: cited files that don't exist
cli.cmd.repo: Link, list, change or remove the repositories the crew watches.
cli.cmd.once: Check every linked repository once and review what's due.
cli.cmd.run: Keep checking linked repositories until you stop it (Ctrl+C).
cli.opt.mode: off, inbox (waits for your approval) or auto (posts right away). Default: inbox.
cli.opt.authors: Whose pull requests to review: others, all or mine. Default: others.
cli.opt.kind: For self-hosted instances whose address doesn't say github or gitlab.
cli.opt.clone: A clone on this machine to borrow objects from on the first fetch.
cli.opt.id: A short name for the repository (default: from its path).
cli.opt.post: Post right away instead of sending the review to the inbox.
cli.opt.dryRun: Only print the review. Nothing is saved or posted.
cli.opt.force: Review even if this commit was already reviewed.
error.noToken: No token for {host}. Sign in with {cli} auth login, or set {env}.
error.unknownRepo: No linked repository called {id}. See crewreview repo list.
error.unknownInboxItem: No review #{id} waiting in the inbox.
repo.added: Linked {id} ({url}). Review: {mode}, authors: {authors}. Signed in as {user}.
repo.none: No repositories linked yet. Add one with: crewreview repo add <url>
review.inboxed: {repo}#{number}: in the inbox as #{id} (findings: {findings}). Post it with: crewreview inbox approve {id}
review.stale: Review #{id} is out of date: the pull request has new commits. It will be reviewed again.
review.mergeOnly: {repo}#{number}: only the base moved since the last review. Nothing new to review.
review.alreadyOnHost: {repo}#{number}: this commit already has a Crewreview review on the host.
skip.label: it has a skip label
skip.too-many-failures: it failed too many times on this commit
run.started: Watching {count} repositories. Press Ctrl+C to stop.
run.stopping: Stopping after the current review… (Ctrl+C again to quit now)
post.delta: Focused on what changed since {sha}, the last commit reviewed.
post.droppedByVerifier.one: The verifier discarded {count} finding after checking the code.
post.droppedByVerifier.other: The verifier discarded {count} findings after checking the code.
post.alreadyDiscussed.one: {count} finding left out because the discussion already covers it.
post.alreadyDiscussed.other: {count} findings left out because the discussion already covers them.
pr.title: Crewreview · {repo}#{number}
